data.body:
CONSOLIDATION — three tickets describe one defect. Naming a canonical so three agents do not solve
it three times.

    846b-4b51-0254-48fd  stuffed-energistic-ladybird   <- CANONICAL
    9c2e-b44c-119e-4105  torrential-unwhite-snail      relates_to (filed first, carries the history)
    bc3e-7f43-2195-4301  dubious-neutral-duck          duplicates (just linked)

All three are the same thing seen from three angles: `gate_admission._slot_dir()` is
`store_root()/locks`, `store_root()` falls back to `tempfile.gettempdir()`, so the four gate
admission slots are **host-global** — shared by every worktree, every session, and every rebar
process on the machine, including ones running no tests at all.

What each contributed, so nothing is lost by consolidating:

- **9c2e** (filed first) recorded the symptom and, in its comments, the xdist-worker angle — four
  `PYTEST_WORKERS` against four slots, with `-n` pinned to the runner's vCPU count (4 on
  ubuntu-latest). That angle is real and is the CI-facing consequence: the gating cell can produce
  a spurious `Verified -1`.
- **846b** established the actual mechanism with the slot-holder table showing all four slots held
  by other sessions' live 15-20 minute LLM gate ops while the observing agent's own pytest count
  was zero — which is why "run it in isolation" does not isolate — plus the fails-closed-without-
  waiting detail and the demonstrated fix (`REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR` private slot dir: 71 passed / 0
  failed).
- **bc3e** is a third independent sighting from the Windows lock work: 8 of 9 `make verify`
  failures, with `ps` showing another session running `review-plan verminous-zealous-krill`, and an
  A/B proving the change under test was not implicated.

Three independent agents hit this within a few hours, which is itself the strongest argument for
its priority: it is not an occasional flake, it is the default condition on a busy host.

Work the fix on **846b**; leave 9c2e and bc3e open only until it lands, then close them against it.
Do not fix the worker/slot ratio alone — that addresses 9c2e's angle and leaves the host-global
exhaustion untouched, which is the one that makes isolation fail.
